scenarios.name: Failed Spawn
scenarios.expected: ABSENT state, null pointer, safe retry on next monotonic snapshot
scenarios.actual: Spawn failure handled cleanly, reverted to ABSENT, subsequent snapshot successfully spawned
scenarios.details: Native factory null return does not poison state or leave dangling pointer.

scenarios.name: Failed Remove
scenarios.expected: Ownership retained or error state flagged if native remove fails
scenarios.actual: Premature transition to ABSENT and pointer discarded (m_nativeActorPtr=null) despite removeVisualActor() returning false
scenarios.details: DEFECT in visual_proxy_state_machine.hpp:252-257. If native remove fails, state machine loses reference to alive KEX actor without cleanup proof.

scenarios.name: Shutdown During Pending Spawn
scenarios.expected: Pending spawn canceled, ABSENT state, 0 native spawns
scenarios.actual: Canceled cleanly, executePendingSpawn returned false, 0 spawns
scenarios.details: forceShutdown canceled pending spawn before native factory was touched.

scenarios.name: Shutdown During Pending Remove
scenarios.expected: Single remove, no double removal, pointer zeroed
scenarios.actual: Removed exactly once via forceShutdown, subsequent executePendingRemove returned false
scenarios.details: Shutdown cleanly finalized pending removal without duplicate call.

scenarios.name: Recycled Actor Pointer / ABA
scenarios.expected: Delayed packet from prior entity/connection rejected despite recycled pointer address
scenarios.actual: Snapshot rejected with IdentityMismatch, new actor at recycled address preserved
scenarios.details: C++ wrapper filters by connectionGen and entityGen. NOTE: Native KEX pointers have no generation tags; native protection relies strictly on C++ wrapper.

scenarios.name: Stale Snapshot After Reconnect
scenarios.actual: Rejected with IdentityMismatch, proxy remained ABSENT
scenarios.details: Connection generation mismatch prevents resurrecting or updating proxy.

scenarios.name: Epoch Invalidation
scenarios.actual: Rejected with IdentityMismatch, proxy remained ABSENT
scenarios.details: Epoch guard prevents snapshots of unloaded level from activating proxy.

scenarios.name: Wrong Slot / Local Player Protection
scenarios.expected: Slot 1 strictly rejected, slot 0 accepted, exactly 1 remote proxy spawned
scenarios.actual: Slot 1 rejected with WrongSlot, only slot 0 spawned, 0 local duplicates
scenarios.details: Local player (Slot 1) protected from phantom proxy duplication.

scenarios.name: Unsafe Thread (Thread Affinity)
scenarios.expected: All operations from foreign thread rejected or throw affinity exception
scenarios.actual: Foreign TID blocked on handleSnapshot, executePendingSpawn, executePendingRemove, forceShutdown
scenarios.details: Worker thread strictly blocked from touching proxy state machine. NOTE: throwing std::runtime_error in production KEX is fatal; must fail closed gracefully.

scenarios.name: Transform After Removal
scenarios.expected: No updateVisualTransform calls after actor removal
scenarios.actual: Transforms count frozen at remove, null actor never updated
scenarios.details: Removed actor cannot receive delayed transform updates.

scenarios.name: Invalid Native Sector (Constant 259 Fallacy)
scenarios.expected: State machine rejects or requires destination sector validation
scenarios.actual: State machine blindly spawned actor in Sector 259 despite coordinates belonging to Sector 176
scenarios.details: CRITICAL FINDING: Hardcoding Sector 259 is an invalid assumption. In real KEX, actor in wrong sector list is culled or corrupts portal rendering. DOC-58B CANNOT assume sector 259 without native sector query.

scenarios.name: Real Source Contract Mismatch
scenarios.expected: Verify real protocol limitations: no sectorId on wire, zero velocity, entityGen=1, distinct MapReady vs gameplay
scenarios.actual: All 4 contract discrepancies verified directly against source code (net_protocol.h, bootstrap.cpp, client.cpp)
scenarios.details: DOC-58B must handle client-side sector derivation and cannot rely on wire velocity/entityGen increments.
